scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n renderer,main,desktop -c cyan,magenta,green "vite --host 127.0.0.1 --port 43127 --strictPort" "tsc -p tsconfig.main.json --watch --preserveWatchOutput" "wait-on tcp:127.0.0.1:43127 dist/main/index.js && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:43127 electron ."
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.main.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --noEmit
scripts.test:e2e: corepack pnpm run build && playwright test
scripts.package: corepack pnpm run build && node ./scripts/run-forge.mjs && corepack pnpm run package:verify
